capabilities.problem: A fixed evidence packet cannot incorporate newly found counterevidence without breaking prior assessment bindings; Stage 1 evidence can also lose its run, work/version or source provenance before Stage 2. Interrupted actions and missing independent reviews need explicit states.
capabilities.mechanism: Import validated Stage 1 deliverables into a v2 packet that binds run/state, handoff, deliverable, canonical records, brief, resources, structured literature metadata/classification/roles/findings, exact claims, source status, exact source bytes and unresolved coverage without inventing candidates or comparison results. Freeze separate Stage 1 literature/source/evidence projections while allowing separately marked Stage 2 additions. Wrap immutable checker snapshots with append-only lineage and action receipts; bind independent initial views, explicit synthesis and seeded excluded-candidate audits. No model runner or semantic endorsement is implied. Prepare packet-bound two-role batches, audit excluded candidates with a saved seed, and preserve incomplete review and bounded follow-up states. Reconstruct an immutable Markdown/HTML proposal package and bind real user-message records and candidate versions to the viewed report; preserve pending choices and return-to-Stage2 conditions. Packet2.1 preserves a separately accepted exploratory intake with false Stage1 eligibility, original source projections and external input hashes; legacy sufficient-handoff semantics stay unchanged. capabilities.problem: Offline records cannot establish that native research, independent review or tool-free extraction executed, and replayed JSON alone can hide changed runtime or source bytes.
capabilities.mechanism: Capture native calls and session records; extract exact saved spans; bind independent reviews and isolated content-first judges to immutable inputs and verified model archives. Functional preflight separately verifies effective policy, native read/write/search/child results and denied sentinel reads; a fresh profile disables discovered personal skills without changing bundled capabilities. Missing inventory or isolation evidence blocks admission. Calibration selects frozen source IDs and restores exact text in the host; case outputs and actual model calls are counted separately. A sequential controller composes existing snapshots and review steps; readonly verifiers reconstruct calls without resume or dispatch. Common prose-to-action extraction records unresolved omissions rather than inventing actions. Versioned calibration units explicitly bind the diagnostic output contract; default legacy 2.0 prompts and archives remain unchanged, while 2.1 transports the judgment basis and witness IDs. Readonly replay selects the frozen output-version schema and rejects a rehashed version downgrade without executing model calls. Inventory receipt2.0 binds five supported RPC responses and separately captured host model-request tools; unknown offered tools block admission and unsupported tools/list is never required. Versioned opt-in followup2 routes material partial findings and repair next steps while retaining legacy behavior; unknown new-method performance alone does not force proof before research. Tool-free rubric QA archives actual R1/R2 calls and separate immutable-input ADJ; injected adapters cannot attest quality and no QA run grants formal readiness. A private no-model app-server observer records supported config, skills, plugin and MCP replies and optional existing-thread metadata; it never dispatches a model, changes settings or treats metadata as per-execution tool or instruction attestation. Incomplete replies remain partial and failures retain their transport bytes. Strict production witness decoding accepts one constant native shell or web-search wrapper and an unmodified result, binds host terminal bytes and child lineage, and rejects dynamic code, crossed waits, substituted executors and user-only child replies; it executes no recorded JavaScript. Ordinary single-harness admission requires only authentic read/write/search/child probes and matching runtime/profile/workspace/config bytes; missing inventory remains observed unknown, supplied bad inventory fails, and production-only proof cannot establish formal A/B isolation.
